projects.name: Smart Construction Site Guardian
projects.stack: Python · LangGraph · AutoGen · YOLOv8-ONNX · RAG · FastAPI
points: Built an end-to-end construction safety intelligent system: visual perception → standard retrieval → risk grading → closed-loop handling → manual correction → retraining feedback, with multi-agent collaborative reasoning and traceable evidence chains.
Self-trained YOLOv8 model deployed via ONNX, enabling first-frame alerting on the real-time pipeline with rule-driven, non-blocking inference, balancing alert timeliness and reasoning depth.
RAG retrieval of safety standard clauses serves as the Agent's decision basis; alerts carry clause citations and image evidence, fully reviewable.
Designed a sample feedback and retraining loop that writes manual corrections back into the dataset, continuously improving detection capability.

projects.name: Office Agent ProjectPack (AMD Radeon Hackathon · Team PLASMA)
projects.stack: Python · AMD ROCm · llama.cpp · FAISS · BM25 · RRF · FastAPI
points: Adapted and deployed Llama 3.1 8B Instruct on AMD ROCm for fully local inference, ensuring data privacy.
Implemented FAISS + BM25 hybrid retrieval with RRF fusion ranking to retrieve project scope evidence and assess task progress from reference files and task lists.
Combined a rule engine with locally adapted models to generate auditable report bundles supporting task progress evaluation and scope evidence retrieval.

projects.name: RAG Medical Assistant
projects.stack: Python · LangGraph · LangChain · FAISS · BM25 · Knowledge Graph
points: Built a governance-oriented medical Q&A agent on LangGraph: hybrid retrieval (Vector + BM25) plus knowledge graph multi-hop reasoning, going beyond single-hop retrieval limits.
A three-tier memory system (short-term context / vector event memory / structured profile) supports personalized continuous consultations.
Role-isolated access control for health records plus compliance guardrails ensure traceable, auditable answers; iteratively optimized with RAGAS evaluation.
